title: Proposition 4.29: reduced closed substacks correspond to open substacks
statement_scope: Let X=(X,OX) be a spectral Deligne-Mumford stack. Let Subred(X) be the full subcategory of Stk/X spanned by closed immersions i:X0→X with X0 reduced. For each object (i:X0→X), let X0^c=i*(∅) for an initial object ∅ of the underlying ∞-topos of X0. Then the construction (i:X0→X)↦X0^c determines an equivalence of ∞-categories Subred(X)≃(τ≤−1 X)^op. The whole proposition and proof are retained.

A genuine structural result above routine qualification work, but its proof is a reduction rather than a large construction.
